description: Returns a new array-of-doubles sketch with the keys (and their summaries) of sketch A that are not in sketch B (set difference)

name: datasketch_aod_column_means
description: Returns the mean of each value column over the retained keys (the mean per distinct key), or NULL if the sketch retains no entries

name: datasketch_aod_column_sums
description: Returns the estimated total of each value column over all distinct keys: the column sums of the retained entries divided by theta (exact when the sketch is not in estimation mode)

name: datasketch_aod_describe
description: Returns a human-readable description of the array-of-doubles sketch

name: datasketch_aod_dissimilarity_test
description: Returns true if the Jaccard similarity of the key sets is at most the threshold, with high confidence (its upper bound is <= threshold)

name: datasketch_aod_estimate
description: Returns the estimated number of distinct keys in the array-of-doubles sketch

name: datasketch_aod_exactly_equal
description: Returns true if the two sketches retain exactly the same keys with the same theta (summaries are not compared)

name: datasketch_aod_get_theta
description: Returns the theta value of the array-of-doubles sketch (the fraction of the key hash space it retains)

name: datasketch_aod_intersect
description: Returns the intersection of two or more array-of-doubles sketches: the keys present in every sketch, with their values summed element-wise

name: datasketch_aod_intersect_agg
description: Intersects array-of-doubles sketches across rows: keeps the keys present in every sketch, summing their values element-wise. NULL sketches are skipped; returns NULL if there are no sketches

name: datasketch_aod_is_empty
description: Returns true if the array-of-doubles sketch is empty

name: datasketch_aod_is_estimation_mode
description: Returns true if the array-of-doubles sketch is in estimation mode (it has sampled the keys)

name: datasketch_aod_jaccard
returnType: STRUCT(lower DOUBLE, estimate DOUBLE, upper DOUBLE)
description: Returns the Jaccard similarity of the key sets of two sketches as a struct of its estimate and approximate lower and upper bounds (about 2 standard deviations). Two empty sketches are identical (1.0)

name: datasketch_aod_lower_bound
description: Returns the lower bound of the estimated number of distinct keys at the given number of standard deviations (1, 2, or 3)

name: datasketch_aod_num_retained
description: Returns the number of entries (keys with their summaries) retained in the array-of-doubles sketch

name: datasketch_aod_num_values
description: Returns the number of values per key of the array-of-doubles sketch

name: datasketch_aod_seed_hash
description: Returns the 16-bit hash of the seed the array-of-doubles sketch was built with; sketches can only be combined if their seed hashes match

name: datasketch_aod_similarity_test
description: Returns true if the Jaccard similarity of the key sets is at least the threshold, with high confidence (its lower bound is >= threshold)

name: datasketch_aod_summaries
description: Returns the retained entries of the array-of-doubles sketch as a list of {hash, values} structs (the key hash and its values)

name: datasketch_aod_to_theta
description: Converts the array-of-doubles sketch to a Theta sketch of its keys (dropping the summaries), usable with the datasketch_theta functions

name: datasketch_aod_union
description: Returns the union of two or more array-of-doubles sketches (values of a key summed element-wise) with the given log2 of nominal entries (lg_k, 4-26)

name: datasketch_aod_union
description: Returns the union of two or more array-of-doubles sketches (values of a key summed element-wise), keeping as many entries as the largest input (at least lg_k 12)

name: datasketch_aod_upper_bound
description: Returns the upper bound of the estimated number of distinct keys at the given number of standard deviations (1, 2, or 3)

description: Returns true if the Tuple sketch is empty

description: Returns true if the Tuple sketch is in estimation mode (it has sampled the keys)

returnType: STRUCT(lower DOUBLE, estimate DOUBLE, upper DOUBLE)
description: Returns the Jaccard similarity of the key sets of two sketches as a struct of its estimate and approximate lower and upper bounds (about 2 standard deviations). Two empty sketches are identical (1.0)

name: datasketch_tuple_lower_bound
description: Returns the lower bound of the estimated number of distinct keys at the given number of standard deviations (1, 2, or 3)

name: datasketch_tuple_mean
description: Returns the mean summary per distinct key (the mean of the retained summaries), or NULL if the sketch retains no entries

name: datasketch_tuple_num_retained
description: Returns the number of entries (keys with their summaries) retained in the Tuple sketch

name: datasketch_tuple_seed_hash
description: Returns the 16-bit hash of the seed the Tuple sketch was built with; sketches can only be combined if their seed hashes match

name: datasketch_tuple_similarity_test
description: Returns true if the Jaccard similarity of the key sets is at least the threshold, with high confidence (its lower bound is >= threshold)

name: datasketch_tuple_sum
description: Returns the estimated total of the summaries over all distinct keys: the sum of the retained summaries divided by theta (with mode 'sum', the estimated sum of the values; exact when the sketch is not in estimation mode)

name: datasketch_tuple_summaries
description: Returns the retained entries of the Tuple sketch as a list of {hash, summary} structs (the key hash and its summary)

name: datasketch_tuple_to_theta
description: Converts the Tuple sketch to a Theta sketch of its keys (dropping the summaries), usable with the datasketch_theta functions

name: datasketch_tuple_union

name: datasketch_tuple_union
description: Returns the union of two or more Tuple sketches, keeping as many entries as the largest input (at least lg_k 12); the summaries of a key are combined by mode := 'sum' (default), 'min', 'max' or 'one'

name: datasketch_tuple_upper_bound
description: Returns the upper bound of the estimated number of distinct keys at the given number of standard deviations (1, 2, or 3)
